subject: 28 Dependabot alerts are open on main, 3 of them critical in next

work_items: Fix or dismiss with a stated reason each open Dependabot alert

description:
Found by card #10, whose check made these alerts visible: the AGENTS.md instruction never queried Dependabot, so they sat open behind a check that printed 0.

MEASURED 2026-10-10 with make check-security-alerts: 28 open of 208 Dependabot alerts, all npm. By severity: 3 critical, 10 high, 12 medium, 3 low. The 3 critical are next in frontend/package-lock.json (alerts #210, #211, #221). The rest cluster in a few packages: ip-address, js-yaml, extract-zip, browserslist, mermaid, brace-expansion, vitest. Two manifests carry them: package-lock.json at the root and frontend/package-lock.json. Regenerate the list rather than trusting it: make check-security-alerts prints every open alert with number, severity, package, manifest and advisory.

CONTEXT. SECURITY.md records that Dependabot security updates are disabled and only weekly version-update PRs run, so nothing opens a fix PR for these. Code scanning has 0 open of 156.

WHY IT MATTERS TO THE BOARD. Card #10 left the alert check non-gating because 28 open alerts would block every push. Clearing this backlog is the precondition for the operator's call on making make check-security-alerts a blocking pre-push or CI step.
